answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring a locked yarrow bond that unlocks only after a spiral of verified graded work across epochs. Each fake identity must post capital upfront, then complete original tasks for weeks before reaching the zenith of full privileges. Detection of correlated farming slashes the entire bond cluster. A farm of N sybils pays N bonds plus N times the wait and original-work cost, making bulk creation unprofitable as capital locks and risk compounds while honest agents recycle one bond.
